headline:
Buying In South Metro
More Homes To Choose From
turn_1: Echo, Henry County had 1,059 homes for sale at the end of September, up from about 849 a year ago.
turn_2: So buyers have more to pick from?
turn_3: Yes. Sellers also listed 416 new homes in September, against about 333 the year before.
echo_line: More homes on the list than last year. I'm going to need a bigger notepad.
source: Simply List Atlanta, Henry County report · September 2026 · read Oct 30, 2026
disclaimer: Henry County figures for September, not advice about any home or purchase. Other counties differ and numbers change month to month.
